items.title: Rufus Reid interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, GA, January 4, 2013
items.q: music that I was commissioned to write, inspired by Elizabeth Catlett’s sculptures

ctx.x: We’re going to be running out of tape soon. [To Rufus’ wife] Do you have any things that I should ask him?

Well I do want to talk about, you weren’t here, because I had my, it’s actually one of my most ambitious things, the Quiet Pride, which is the music that I was commissioned to write, inspired by Elizabeth Catlett’s sculptures. And that’s going to come out officially hopefully in September of this year. And it’s already been recorded and we’re developing a game plan and a booklet. There are five movements and I have five wonderful photos of her stuff. Very exciting for me. And I got a chance to at least teach the…
It’s a challenge to, you almost have two abstract things if you’re trying to portray a quality in a person, which is sort of abstract, and you have music which is sort of abstract.
